title: Zero-Shot Speech LLMs for Multi-Aspect Evaluation of L2 Speech: Challenges and Opportunities

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing score distributions using histograms to identify the model's tendency to cluster its predictions in a narrow mid-to-high range (7-9) while avoiding extreme lower scores across all evaluation rubrics.

Comparing model-generated pronunciation scores against human ground-truth ratings specifically for low-quality utterances (scores <= 6) to detect the model's systematic failure to assign correspondingly low scores.
